text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi—

Looking where Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was pointing,
there was a crane game filled with
stuffed plushies modeled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Are you good at this, by any chance?
Are you good at this, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, actually the opposite.
I'm not really good with that kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: My little sisters begged me for it once before, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I got a bit too eager and ended up messing it up.
Ahaha, how embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanted to win them
for my little sisters, though."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
!? Are you sure?
In that case, I'd love to!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please let me observe your moves
for future reference, Trainer!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
